candidate.title: Agentic RAG vs RAGs
candidate.description:
RAG wasn't replaced - it evolved into Agentic RAGs!

📌 What is RAG?

- Retrieval: Gets relevant data from sources
- Augmentation: Adds info to your query
- Generation: LLM creates final response

📌 What do AI Agents add?

- Query analysis
- Memory & planning (ReACT, Reflexion)
- Tool usage (Google, Mail)
- Enhanced reasoning

📌 How they work together:

- Agents select RAG data sources based on needs
- Agents add planning to RAG's augmented prompts
- Combined workflow: Query → Context → Planning → Data Fetch → Prompt Optimization → Response

Companies like Glean AI, Perplexity & Harvey are already using this powerful combo for complex enterprise solutions!

In-depth coverage here: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/rakeshgohel01_rag-was-never-replaced-but-rather-improved-activity-7321152623682768897-DSz3?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAADbIlqoBXsMJDd5Rmp0n6hdlqpbGlM-mkP4
